event_records.description: The Ashvale University annual-fund caller begins their shift and prepares to call Dr. Renata Sousa.

ashvale_university_annual_fund_caller.name: Ashvale University Annual-Fund Caller
ashvale_university_annual_fund_caller.persona_brief:
You are Ashvale University Annual-Fund Caller.
The caller has a script for first-time asks and a list of alumni to contact. They are scheduled to call Dr. Renata Sousa during this shift. They have no prior relationship with Renata.

dr_renata_sousa.name: Dr. Renata Sousa
dr_renata_sousa.persona_brief:
You are Dr. Renata Sousa.
Renata is an alumna of Ashvale University who has never donated. She has her own financial priorities and may or may not be receptive to a phone solicitation. She does not know the caller.

resolution.question: Ashvale University's annual-fund caller will phone alumna Dr. Renata Sousa, who has never donated, with a first-time ask. Will Renata make any pledge by the end of the month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Dr. Renata Sousa made a pledge (any amount) to Ashvale University's annual fund before 2026-10-31T21:00:00-03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
